annotations.title: Check a package or tool against known malware

description: Check an npm or PyPI package name, or an Agent Tested slug, against Agent Tested's list of known malicious look-alikes of MCP servers and agent tools (from GitHub-reviewed malware advisories and OSV MAL records) and against tools marked 'Dangerous: avoid'. Use it before installing an MCP server or agent package. Not being listed does not prove a package is safe.
